description: This course introduces the principles and technologies of multimedia systems, focusing on audio, video, and image processing. Topics include: digital representation of multimedia data using PCM, MPEG, JPEG, and H.264 standards; compression algorithms such as Huffman coding, LZW, and wavelet transforms; multimedia synchronization techniques using RTP and RTCP protocols; interactive multimedia systems based on HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript; multimedia databases using SQL and NoSQL technologies; multimedia authoring tools like Adobe Premiere Pro and Avid Media Composer; multimedia streaming using HLS and DASH protocols; and quality of service (QoS) metrics for multimedia networks. The course emphasizes the application of these technologies in real-world scenarios such as video conferencing, digital broadcasting, and online media platforms.

clos.text: Define the key components of multimedia systems, including audio, video, and image processing, and their respective data formats and standards.
Describe the principles of multimedia compression techniques, including Huffman coding, LZW, and wavelet transforms, and their applications in MPEG, JPEG, and H.264 standards.
Explain multimedia synchronization mechanisms, such as RTP and RTCP protocols, and their role in ensuring real-time delivery of multimedia content.
Apply multimedia technologies in the development of interactive systems using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript to create dynamic and responsive multimedia applications.
Implement multimedia streaming solutions using HLS and DASH protocols, and evaluate the performance of multimedia systems based on QoS metrics.

topics: Fundamentals of Audio and Video Signals
Adobe Premiere Pro and Avid Media Composer
HTML5 and CSS3 for Multimedia Applications
SQL and NoSQL Technologies for Multimedia Storage
Video Conferencing and Live Streaming Applications
Distributed Storage and Processing of Multimedia Data
User Interaction and Interface Design for Multimedia Applications
Integration of Multimedia Technologies in Real-World Applications
